title: Amos 1:1 (#2)
content:
What was Amos’ occupation?

Amos was a shepherd.

title: Amos 1:1 (#1)
content:
How did Amos receive the message he spoke concerning Israel?

Amos received the message he spoke concerning Israel in a vision given to him by Yahweh.

title: Amos 1:2 (#1)
content:
What happens to the pastures and the top of Mount Carmel when Yahweh speaks?

The pastures where shepherds usually feed their sheep and the top of Mount Carmel dry up and wither.

title: Amos 1:3 (#1)
content:
Why did Yahweh declare punishment against Damascus?

Yahweh declared punishment against Damascus because they cruelly attacked the people of Gilead.

title: Amos 1:4 (#1)
content:
What did Yahweh say he would send into the house of Hazael?

He said he would send a fire that would destroy the house of Hazael and the citadels of Ben Hadad.

title: Amos 1:5 (#1)
content:
Where will the people of Aram go into exile?

They will go into exile to the land of Kir.

title: Amos 1:6 (#1)
content:
Why did Yahweh declare punishment against Gaza?

Yahweh said he would punish Gaza because they captured whole people groups and sold them as slaves to Edom.

title: Amos 1:7 (#1)
content:
What did Yahweh declare he would do to the fortresses of Gaza?

Yahweh declared he would burn down the fortresses of Gaza.

title: Amos 1:8 (#1)
content:
What will happen to the rest of the Philistines?

All the Philistines who are still alive will die.

title: Amos 1:9 (#1)
content:
Why did Yahweh declare punishment against Tyre?

Yahweh declared punishment against Tyre because they exiled whole people groups to Edom and broke their treaty.

title: Amos 1:10 (#1)
content:
What did Yahweh declare he would do to the wall of Tyre?

He declared he would send a fire that would destroy the walls of Tyre.

title: Amos 1:11 (#1)
content:
Why did Yahweh declare punishment against Edom?

Yahweh declared punishment against Edom because he killed their own kinsmen.

title: Amos 1:12 (#1)
content:
What did Yahweh declare he would do to Teman?

He declared he would send a fire on Teman that would also burn down the citadels of Bozrah.

title: Amos 1:13 (#1)
content:
Why did Yahweh declare punishment against Ammon?

Yahweh declared punishment against Ammon because they ripped open the pregnant women of Gilead.

title: Amos 1:14 (#1)
content:
What did Yahweh declare he would do to the citadels of Rabbah?

Yahweh declared he would completely destroy the walls of the city of Rabbah and burn down her citadels.

title: Amos 1:15 (#1)
content:
What did Yahweh declare would happen to the king of Ammon?

Yahweh declared the king of Ammon would be exiled with all his officials.

title: Amos 2:1 (#1)
content:
Why did Yahweh declare punishment against Moab?

Yahweh declared punishment against Moab because they burned the bones of the king of Edom.

title: Amos 2:2 (#1)
content:
What did Yahweh say he would do to the city of Kerioth?

Yahweh said he would send a fire that would destroy the fortresses of the city of Kerioth.

title: Amos 2:3 (#1)
content:
What did Yahweh declare he would do to the judge and other leaders of Moab?

Yahweh declared that he would kill the judge and officials of Moab.

title: Amos 2:4 (#1)
content:
Why did Yahweh declare punishment against Judah?

Yahweh declared punishment against Judah because Judah rejected the law of Yahweh.

title: Amos 2:5 (#1)
content:
What did Yahweh declare he would do to the fortresses of Jerusalem?

Yahweh declared he would burn down the fortresses of Jerusalem.

title: Amos 2:6 (#1)
content:
What did the people of Israel do to the righteous and the needy?

The people of Israel sold the righteous for silver and the needy for a pair of sandals.

title: Amos 2:7 (#1)
content:
Why did Yahweh declare punishment against Israel?

Yahweh declared punishment against Israel because Israel was oppressing poor people.

title: Amos 2:8 (#1)
content:
What did the people of Israel do in the temple?

They drank wine bought with fines in the temple of their God.

title: Amos 2:9 (#1)
content:
How had the Israelites been able to defeat the Amorites?

The Israelites had been able to defeat the Amorites because Yahweh destroyed the Amorites for them.

title: Amos 2:10 (#1)
content:
What did Yahweh do for the Israelites after he brought them out of Egypt?

Yahweh led the Israelites in the wilderness for forty years and gave them the land of the Amorites as their own.

title: Amos 2:11 (#1)
content:
Whom did Yahweh choose from among the Israelites?

Yahweh chose some of their young men to be prophets and others to be Nazirites.

title: Amos 2:12 (#1)
content:
What did the Israelites do with the prophets Yahweh had chosen for them?

The Israelites commanded the prophets not to prophesy.

title: Amos 2:12 (#2)
content:
What did the Israelites do with the Nazirites Yahweh had chosen from among them?

The Israelites forced the Nazirites to break their vows not to drink wine.

title: Amos 2:13 (#1)
content:
What did Yahweh declare he would do to Israel?

Yahweh declared he would make them unable to escape his punishment.

title: Amos 2:14 (#1)
content:
What will the swift person, the strong person, and the mighty person not be able to do?

The swift person will not be able to run fast enough to escape, the strong person will not be able to add to his own strength, and the mighty person will not be able to rescue himself.

title: Amos 2:15 (#1)
content:
What did Yahweh declare concerning archers, fast runners, and horsemen?

Yahweh declared that none of them would be able to save themselves when he comes to punish the nation.

title: Amos 3:1 (#1)
content:
Against whom is this word of Yahweh?

This word of Yahweh is against the people of Israel, the descendants of those who Yahweh brought up out of Egypt.

title: Amos 3:2 (#1)
content:
Who did Yahweh choose from all the people groups of the earth?

Yahweh chose Israel from all the people groups of the earth.

title: Amos 3:3 (#1)
content:
What must two persons do in order to walk together?

Two persons must agree in order to walk together.

title: Amos 3:4 (#1)
content:
When does a lion roar in the forest?

A lion roars in the forest only when it has caught prey.

title: Amos 3:5 (#1)
content:
When does a bird get caught in a trap on the ground?

A bird gets caught in a trap on the ground only when someone has set a trap for it.

title: Amos 3:6 (#1)
content:
When disaster comes on a city, who has sent it?

When disaster comes on a city, Yahweh has sent it.

title: Amos 3:7 (#1)
content:
What does Yahweh do before he takes action?

Yahweh reveals his plan to his prophets before he takes action.

title: Amos 3:8 (#1)
content:
What must the prophets do when the Lord Yahweh speaks?

When the Lord Yahweh speaks, the prophets must proclaim what he says.

title: Amos 3:9 (#1)
content:
What would these other nations see if they could observe what was happening in Samaria?

They would see how the people are panicking and how the rulers are oppressing the people of Samaria.

title: Amos 3:10 (#1)
content:
What were the people of Samaria storing up in their fortresses?

Samaria was storing up the things they obtained through violence and destruction in their fortresses.

title: Amos 3:11 (#1)
content:
What punishment does Yahweh declare against Israel?

Yahweh declares that an enemy will plunder and tear down the fortresses of Israel.

title: Amos 3:12 (#1)
content:
Who will escape Yahweh’s punishment?

Only a few will escape Yahweh’s punishment.

title: Amos 3:14 (#1)
content:
At the time when Yahweh will punish Israel for their sins, what else will he do?

Yahweh will also destroy the altars where they worship at Bethel.

title: Amos 3:15 (#1)
content:
What will Yahweh do to the houses of the wealthy?

Yahweh will destroy all the big fancy houses of the wealthy.

title: Amos 4:1 (#2)
content:
What are the rich women in Samaria doing to the poor?

The rich women are oppressing the poor and causing the needy to suffer.

title: Amos 4:1 (#1)
content:
What name does Yahweh give the rich women who live in Samaria?

Yahweh calls the rich women of Samaria cows of Bashan.

title: Amos 4:2 (#1)
content:
What does Yahweh declare will happen to the rich women in Samaria?

Yahweh declares that he allow their enemies to take these women away as captives.

title: Amos 4:3 (#1)
content:
What will the wealthy women do when enemies break through the walls of the city?

Each woman will go out through the gap in the wall.

title: Amos 4:4–5 (#1)
content:
What have the people of Israel loved to do?

The people of Israel loved to bring sacrifices and tithes and announce their freewill offerings but not in the way that Yahweh commanded them to do.

title: Amos 4:6 (#1)
content:
What did Yahweh cause to happen to the people of Israel?

Yahweh caused a famine so that the people of Israel had no food in any of their cities.

title: Amos 4:7 (#1)
content:
What did Yahweh do so that the people of Israel would return to him?

Yahweh withheld rain from Israel so that the people of Israel would return to him.

title: Amos 4:8 (#1)
content:
What did the people do when they had no water in their cities?

The people staggered to another city to get water, but they did not get enough.

title: Amos 4:9 (#1)
content:
What did Yahweh do to the gardens, vineyards, and trees so that the people of Israel would return to him?

Yahweh caused locusts to eat all their gardens, vineyards, and fig and olive trees.

title: Amos 4:10 (#1)
content:
What did Yahweh do to the young men so that the people of Israel would return to him?

Yahweh allowed their enemies to kill the young men in wars so that the people of Israel would return to him.

title: Amos 4:11 (#1)
content:
What did Yahweh do to some of the people of Israel so that they would return to him?

Yahweh destroyed some of the people of Israel so that they would return to him.

title: Amos 4:12 (#1)
content:
What does Yahweh tell the people of Israel they must now prepare to do?

Yahweh tells the people of Israel they must now prepare to meet their God.

title: Amos 4:13 (#1)
content:
Who formed the mountains and revealed what people are thinking?

Yahweh, God of Armies, formed the mountains and revealed what people are thinking.

title: Amos 5:1 (#1)
content:
Who is the prophet lamenting?

The people of Israel are the ones the prophet is mourning over.

title: Amos 5:3 (#1)
content:
What does Yahweh say will happen to a town that sends out a thousand soldiers to fight?

A town that sends out a thousand soldiers to fight will have only a hundred who survive.

title: Amos 5:4 (#1)
content:
What does Yahweh tell the people of Israel to do?

Yahweh tells the people of Israel to sincerely worship him again him so they can live.

title: Amos 5:5 (#1)
content:
What three places does Yahweh tell the people not to go to worship?

Yahweh tells them not to go to Bethel, Gilgal, or Beersheba.

title: Amos 5:6 (#1)
content:
What will happen to the house of Joseph if they do not seek Yahweh?

Yahweh will destroy them completely, and no one will be able to stop it.

title: Amos 5:7 (#1)
content:
How do the people treat justice and righteousness, according to Yahweh?

They make unjust decisions, and they completely reject right living.

title: Amos 5:8 (#1)
content:
What is the name of the one who made the stars, turns darkness into morning, and makes the waters of the sea into rain that falls on the whole earth?

His name is Yahweh.

title: Amos 5:9 (#1)
content:
What does Yahweh do to those who are strong?

Yahweh brings sudden destruction on the strong.

title: Amos 5:10 (#1)
content:
Who do the strong hate and abhor?

The strong hate those who correct them, and abhor anyone who speaks the truth.

title: Amos 5:11 (#1)
content:
What will happen to those who oppress the poor?

Those who oppress the poor will not benefit from the things they work for.

title: Amos 5:12 (#1)
content:
What do the people do to the needy at the gate?

They treat the needy unjustly and send them away when they bring their legal matters to the leaders to decide.

title: Amos 5:13 (#1)
content:
What does a prudent person do at such an evil time?

A prudent person stays silent at such an evil time.

title: Amos 5:14 (#1)
content:
What should the people do so that Yahweh will be with them?

The people should try to do good and not evil, so that Yahweh will be with them.

title: Amos 5:15 (#1)
content:
What does Yahweh tell the people to do, so that he might be gracious to the remnant of Joseph?

Yahweh tells them to hate evil, love good, and establish justice in the gate.

title: Amos 5:16–17 (#1)
content:
What will be heard in all the public places when Yahweh comes to punish them?

Wailing and cries of mourning will be heard in all the public places when Yahweh passes through the people’s midst to punish them.

title: Amos 5:18 (#1)
content:
What will happen to those who are desiring the day of Yahweh to come?

Terrible things will happen to them; the day of Yahweh will be darkness, not light.

title: Amos 5:19 (#1)
content:
What happens to a man in this illustration who flees from a lion?

He flees the lion only to have a bear meet him, and he goes into his house to be safe only to have a snake bite him.

title: Amos 5:20 (#1)
content:
What will the day of Yahweh be?

The day of Yahweh will be a time of punishment for his people that will make them deeply sad.

title: Amos 5:21 (#1)
content:
What does Yahweh say about the people’s feasts and assemblies?

Yahweh says he hates their religious celebrations and their assemblies.

title: Amos 5:22 (#1)
content:
What does Yahweh say he will do if the people offer him burnt offerings and grain offerings?

Yahweh says he will not accept them.

title: Amos 5:23 (#1)
content:
What does Yahweh say about the people’s songs and music?

Yahweh says their songs are just noise to him, and he will not listen to their music.

title: Amos 5:24 (#1)
content:
What does Yahweh want to see people continually doing?

Yahweh wants to see people treating people fairly and doing what is right.

title: Amos 5:25 (#1)
content:
What does Yahweh say the people did not bring him during the forty years in the wilderness?

Yahweh says they did not bring him sacrifices and grain offerings.

title: Amos 5:26 (#1)
content:
What had the people made for themselves?

The people had made for themselves idols that were images of the false gods they were worshiping.

title: Amos 5:27 (#1)
content:
Where will Yahweh send the people?

Yahweh will exile the people beyond Damascus.

title: Amos 6:1 (#1)
content:
Who is Amos warning of Yahweh’s judgment?

Amos is warning the leaders in Zion and Samaria that terrible things will happen to them.

title: Amos 6:2 (#1)
content:
What cities does Yahweh tell the people of Israel to compare themselves to?

Yahweh tells them to go see Calneh, Hamath Rabbah, and Gath of the Philistines.

title: Amos 6:3 (#1)
content:
What do these people refuse to think about?

They refuse to think about the time that is coming when Yahweh will punish them.

title: Amos 6:4 (#1)
content:
What do these people eat while lying on beds of ivory and sprawling on their couches?

They eat young rams from the flock and calves from the stall.

title: Amos 6:5–6 (#1)
content:
What are those being warned doing with their time?

Those being warned are wasting their time idly playing musical instruments, drinking wine, and anointing themselves with the finest oil.

title: Amos 6:6 (#1)
content:
What are those being warned not doing that they should be doing?

Those being warned are not grieving over the destruction of the descendants of Joseph as they should.

title: Amos 6:7 (#1)
content:
Where are those being warned now going?

Those being warned are going to be forced to go into exile.

title: Amos 6:8 (#1)
content:
What does Yahweh hate about these people of Jacob?

Yahweh hates the pride and fortresses of these people of Jacob.

title: Amos 6:9 (#1)
content:
What will happen if even ten men survive in one house?

Even if ten men remain in one house, they will die.

title: Amos 6:10 (#1)
content:
Who will carry the dead body out of the house?

The dead man’s relative, the one who will burn his corpse, will carry the body out of the house.

title: Amos 6:11 (#1)
content:
What will happen to the houses of these people?

Their houses will be smashed to bits.

title: Amos 6:12 (#1)
content:
What have these people done instead of acting justly and righteously?

Instead of treating people justly, they have killed them, and instead of doing good for each other, they have made each other angry and resentful.

title: Amos 6:13 (#1)
content:
What do these people boast about capturing?

They boast about capturing the towns of Lo Debar and Karnaim by their own strength.

title: Amos 6:14 (#1)
content:
What does Yahweh declare he will do against the people of Israel?

Yahweh declares he will bring a foreign nation to attack Israel.

title: Amos 7:1 (#1)
content:
In his vision, what did Amos see Yahweh doing when the second crop of the season was starting to grow?

Amos saw Yahweh forming a locust swarm that would destroy the crop.

title: Amos 7:2–3 (#1)
content:
What was Yahweh’s response when Amos asked him to forgive and not send the swarm of locusts to punish his people?

Yahweh changed his mind and declared that this disaster would not happen.

title: Amos 7:4 (#1)
content:
In his vision, what did Amos see Yahweh summoning to punish his people?

Amos saw Yahweh bringing fire to punish his people.

title: Amos 7:5–6 (#1)
content:
What was Yahweh’s response when Amos asked him not to bring fire to punish the people?

Yahweh again relented and declared that this disaster would not happen either.

title: Amos 7:7 (#1)
content:
In his vision, where did Amos see the Lord standing?

Amos saw the Lord standing beside a wall with a plumb line in his hand.

title: Amos 7:8 (#1)
content:
What did the Lord say was the meaning of the plumb line?

The Lord said the plumb line meant he was going to test whether the Israelites were living rightly and this time, he would not hold back from punishing them.

title: Amos 7:9 (#1)
content:
What did Yahweh declare he would do to Israel?

Yahweh declared he would destroy the hilltop shrines and other holy places in Israel.

title: Amos 7:10 (#1)
content:
What did Amaziah the priest accuse Amos of doing?

Amaziah accused Amos of conspiring against Jeroboam, king of Israel.

title: Amos 7:11 (#1)
content:
What had Amos prophesied about Jeroboam?

Amos had prophesied that Jeroboam would be killed in battle.

title: Amos 7:12 (#1)
content:
Where did Amaziah tell Amos to flee to if he wanted to continue to prophesy?

Amos was told to flee to the land of Judah and prophesy there.

title: Amos 7:13 (#1)
content:
What did Amaziah tell Amos not to do at Bethel?

Amaziah told Amos not to prophesy at Bethel again, because it is the king’s sanctuary and a royal temple.

title: Amos 7:14 (#1)
content:
What was Amos’ work before Yahweh took him to be his prophet?

Amos was a herdsman and keeper of sycamore fig trees.

title: Amos 7:15 (#1)
content:
Why did Amos leave his work tending a flock of sheep?

Yahweh took him away from tending his sheep when he told him to go prophesy to the people of Israel.

title: Amos 7:16 (#1)
content:
What did Amos say that Amaziah was telling him not to do?

Amaziah was telling him not to prophesy against Israel or preach against the descendants of Isaac.

title: Amos 7:17 (#1)
content:
What did Yahweh prophesy against Amaziah, priest of Bethel?

Yahweh declared that Amaziah would die in an foreign land, his wife would be a prostitute, his sons and daughters would be killed, and his land would be divided up.

title: Amos 8:1 (#1)
content:
What did Yahweh show Amos in this vision?

Yahweh showed Amos a basket of summer fruit.

title: Amos 8:2 (#1)
content:
What did Yahweh say had come for his people Israel?

Yahweh said the end had come for his people Israel.

title: Amos 8:3 (#1)
content:
What did Yahweh say would happen to the songs of the temple in that day?

Yahweh said the songs of the temple would turn into wailing because of the many corpses everywhere.

title: Amos 8:4 (#1)
content:
What sins had the people of Israel committed?

The people of Israel had oppressed needy people and gotten rid of poor people in the land.

title: Amos 8:5 (#1)
content:
Why were the people anxious for the new moon and Sabbath to be over?

The people were anxious because they wanted to sell grain again and cheat their customers.

title: Amos 8:6 (#1)
content:
What were some of the things the merchants were doing

They were buying poor and needy people as slaves and selling worthless chaff along with the wheat.

title: Amos 8:7 (#1)
content:
What did Yahweh say he would never do?

Yahweh said he would never forget any of the people’s evil actions.

title: Amos 8:8 (#1)
content:
What did Yahweh say the land would do because of Yahweh’s punishment of people’s sins?

Yahweh said the land would tremble, heaving up and down, and everyone in it would mourn.

title: Amos 8:9 (#1)
content:
When Yahweh punishes Israel, what did he say he would do to the sun?

In that day, Yahweh said he would make the sun set at noon.

title: Amos 8:10 (#1)
content:
What would the people wear when Yahweh punishes them?

The people would wear sackcloth to show that they were grieving.

title: Amos 8:11 (#1)
content:
What famine did Yahweh say he would send in the land?

Yahweh said he would send a famine in the land, not a famine of food or water, but a famine of hearing the words of Yahweh.

title: Amos 8:12 (#1)
content:
What would the people search for but not find?

The people would search for a message from Yahweh but would not find it.

title: Amos 8:13 (#1)
content:
At that time, who would faint from thirst?

At that time, even the young women men would faint from thirst.

title: Amos 8:14 (#1)
content:
Who does Yahweh say would never rise again?

Those who swear by the idols and false gods would never rise again.

title: Amos 9:1 (#1)
content:
Who will escape the Lord’s judgment of Israel?

Not one of them will escape the Lord’s judgment.

title: Amos 9:2 (#1)
content:
What will the Lord do if people to escape his judgment and hide?

No matter where they try to hide, the Lord will find them.

title: Amos 9:3 (#1)
content:
What will the Lord do to those who might think they could hide on the bottom of the sea?

The Lord will give orders to the sea serpent to bite them.

title: Amos 9:4 (#1)
content:
For what purpose will the Lord watch over Israel?

The Lord will watch over Israel to bring them harm or punishment.

title: Amos 9:5 (#1)
content:
What do the people do when Yahweh touches the earth to melt it?

The people will mourn when Yahweh touches the earth to melt it.

title: Amos 9:6 (#1)
content:
What is the name of the one who does all these things?

His name is Yahweh.

title: Amos 9:7 (#1)
content:
From where did Yahweh bring Israel?

Yahweh brought Israel from the land of Egypt.

title: Amos 9:7 (#2)
content:
From where did Yahweh bring the Philistines?

Yahweh brought the Philistines from Caphtor.

title: Amos 9:8 (#1)
content:
Does Yahweh say he will totally destroy all the people of Israel?

No, Yahweh says he will not totally destroy the people of Israel but only the sinful northern kingdom.

title: Amos 9:9 (#1)
content:
What will Yahweh do to the house of Israel among the nations?

Yahweh will shake the house of Israel among the nations like grain in a sieve to determine who is faithful and who is not.

title: Amos 9:10 (#1)
content:
What were the sinners in Israel saying, those that Yahweh will kill?

The sinners were saying that nothing bad will happen to them.

title: Amos 9:11 (#1)
content:
In that day, what does Yahweh say he will restore?

In that day, Yahweh says that he will restore the kingdom that King David once ruled.

title: Amos 9:12 (#1)
content:
According to Yahweh, what will the people of Israel possess?

According to Yahweh, they will possess the remnant of Edom and all the nations that belong to him.

title: Amos 9:13 (#1)
content:
With what does Yahweh say the mountains will drip and the hills will melt in the coming days?

In the coming days, it will seem as if the mountains will drip and the hills will melt with sweet wine.

title: Amos 9:14 (#1)
content:
From what does Yahweh promise to bring Israel back?

Yahweh promises to bring Israel back from captivity.

title: Amos 9:15 (#1)
content:
After Yahweh brings Israel back, who will remove them from their land?

After Yahweh brings Israel back, no one will be able to remove them completely.
